rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that two things are close in space, time, or relationship.

example.english: My home is in close proximity to the MTR station.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 tung4 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hou2 kan5

rows.note: Use this when discussing proximity explicitly as a measurable or technical degree rather than making a simple everyday statement.

example.english: The report compared the proximity of the two areas.
example.traditional: 份報告比較咗兩個地區嘅接近程度。
example.jyutping: fan2 bou3 gou3 bei2 gaau3 zo2 loeng5 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 zip3 gan6 cing4 dou6
